notes.title: 【Playmeow】The sweet and cheerful life of living together✨《Moving in with My Step-sister》 Released!!🚌
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/e3c4a21c600caadbe2c42cfe4c070e28ddca3a78.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1994010/_/

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/63f6fa8f520fb6dcf0c7e17959838b29ddf607c2.jpg[/img]

[h2]🥧◆Story🥧[/h2]
After graduation, I lived alone in a big city, far away from home, in order to pursue my dream.🎐
In contrast to the hustle and bustle of the big city, my daily routine and work were always the same, split up by nothing but a daily commute between home and the restaurant I worked for.
I thought I'd just live a quiet life, plain as water, until one day I got a phone call...

The voice on the other end of the line was my mother.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/52d2bdd242f047e7d6288dd92de07a8913af4715.jpg[/img]

"Well, your sister has found a new job, this time in the city where you live, so she'll be coming over to stay with you for a few days. Please take care of her."🍀
Before I could respond, my mother hung up the phone quickly on the other end.
"Ah..." After I put the phone down, I felt restless.

The sister she mentioned on the phone was actually the daughter of my stepfather and his ex-wife. Although we had lived together since we were children, we were more like friends than siblings.
Suddenly, we had to live together for a few days. Even though she was my sister, I couldn't help but feel nervous...

[h2]🍄◆Gameplay Instructions🍄[/h2]
The protagonist travels between his flat and his workplace every day, while his stepsister has special SMS conversations with him during his breaks from work.
Through these SMS conversation options, you can increase his bond with his stepsister to unlock sex events.
In addition to SMS conversations, cooking and buying gifts will affect his bond with his stepsister. 🎁

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/d6ef37c08e17abef8195f89add296870f887c1b2.png[/img]

Going to work will earn money which can be used to buy gifts to improve your sister's popularity.
In addition to SMS conversations, cooking and buying gifts can also affect your sister's popularity.

[h2]🍳◆Special Cooking Game🍳[/h2]
Follow the recipe, add the ingredients in proportion, and control the heat to create delicious dishes for your stepsister !The more you complete a dish, the more your sister's popularity will increase!🧇

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/f6961680203a5880f3212302124ee40d5f64ded1.jpg[/img]

Enjoy various reactions and episodes while flirting with your stepsister!

[h2]👙◆Game Features👙[/h2]
◇A sweet love simulation game💘
◇Mouse corresponds to the overall operation
◇Live 2D dynamic HCG
◇SMS special dialogue system
◇Cooking game
◇Full Screen: Alt+Enter

notes.title: 【Playmeow】A light of hope in a doomsday crisis🌹 《Doomsday Robot Girl》Let Emma take you on the most healing journey of your life today!!🌟
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/54950a20030ac172d688143602383a791d45a198.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1870310/_/

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/8cc125b2f26d9df354b16dc5cebdb4ba0a31938d.jpg[/img]

[h2]🍲◆Story🍲[/h2]
The post-war world was awful.
The harsh conditions and repeated witnessing of the most twisted side of human nature could make even the most optimistic person lose the will to survive.🥀

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/928ccd861808b5e866a2d6b4938f73a17919bac2.jpg[/img]

No one would believe it. With this in mind, I met Emma, a young girl who claimed to be a military robot. She asked to come with me and offered to give me everything she had.☔

Emma was strange, with little common sense. She was always expressionless and said that sex was a way to relieve stress. She even initiated physical contact with me and said she was used to it...🪶

What had she been through and what was she hiding?🐦

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/d73aefd62b2e2f3ad85572ec75cff4c00a5df58e.jpg[/img]

After I spent some time with Emma, she gradually took on a different look. The sadness in Emma's eyes was slowly revealed and I began to enjoy her company, forgetting for a while that I was still in the middle of doomsday.🫕

Suffering was approaching. Should we face it or escape? The physical and psychological choices that we had to make were difficult.
Could we really find hope in this desperate doomsday?🌻

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/07186a9ec8343b3ae8ab33614fccd798a6a942d8.jpg[/img]

[h2]🍲◆Gameplay Instructions🍲[/h2]
The game is a combination of exploration, basic combat, and development simulation.
At the beginning of the day, the player can choose a place to “explore,” to “chat” with Emma, or to go further with “physical contact” to increase interaction. As the days pass, more events can be triggered. Differences in Emma's favorability and the player’s choices will lead to different futures.🪺

Remember, the world is in ruins. Your surroundings will always remind you when you accidentally forget.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/e06c2e64e3dc2265e58150b2d73d016b65ee40f9.png[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/fceffb93e30f82a8052a68e72c7ea8ac93cea9f0.jpg[/img]

[h2]🍲◆Game Features🍲[/h2]
◇23 basic CGs, including more than 250 differentials◇Game text: 100,000
◇One main female character and one secondary female character
◇Doomsday themed, survival- and simulation-style game
◇Gory, violent content included
◇Game endings: 5 types

notes.title: 【Playmeow】Only children make choices, I want them all 🎭《MILF Conditioning》brings you the most powerful harem!!!💥
notes.content:

[h2]🚗◆Story🚗[/h2]
I was worried about not being able to pay rent to the landlord when I inadvertently rescued the landlord's wife, Sophia. 📸

"I-I'm sorry, I… I didn't mean to cause you any trouble…" Sophia sobbed timidly.
"What do you want?" The landlord glanced at you condescendingly.
Your acts of kindness were rewarded not with gratitude but with the contempt of those who thought they were higher in status. 💸
Flashes of the landlady's cowardice and Landlord Okamoto's condescension ran through your head.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/2384d33614256633bd69d81b247e63841718e679.png[/img]

The memory of the landlady's huge breasts, her silvery hair, and her deer-like eyes made you swallow…
The corners of your mouth lifted in a teasing smile, a smile that was a little cruel.
Sofia cowered, with tears in her eyes, in face of the man who demanded carnal service in return for his rescue.
No more pretending! Showdown! I'm a bad guy~ 😈

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/e66a61da6b88c47c8be53e6f7bbee35234f9695f.png[/img]

[h2]🚗◆Gameplay Instruction🚗[/h2] 
At the beginning of the game you have three opportunities to act each day and a fixed amount of money will be spent each day.

[Conditioning] can increase Sophia's slavery value🥊
[Work] can increase money🧰
[Go out] can trigger new storylines or spend money to regain stamina👣

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35300011/e2590b6636936ec03d18da73a824eb1be22a3a7b.png[/img]

Sophia's slavery value is necessary to trigger [Sex Event], but some of the game's CGs need to be combined with other conditions such as items, days, etc. in order to be unlocked. [Sex Event] with Sophia's daughter can be triggered after opening the 3rd new job, so you should work hard~ 👅

Some of the stories need to be triggered during the [Evening] time.💗
